verdict.rationale: MotherDuck exposes a lot of its functionality programmatically. There are official SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java), a Postgres endpoint, and a Wasm client. Many tasks are done through SQL: secrets via CREATE SECRET, DuckLake databases via CREATE DATABASE, and usage monitoring via MD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA views. The remote MCP server offers read-write SQL, Guides, and Dive generation, and an OpenAPI spec is published. However, nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and several UI-side capabilities have no shown API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of org/user/role administration and billing dashboard functions, documented programmatic share management, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
